attrs.requirement: The system shall hold `AuthCookieMutation`, `userDeletionMutation` in _csrfExempt, which _isExempted reads.
attrs.title: Access table: _csrfExempt

attrs.requirement: The system shall accept a request checked by `ValidateCSRF` only when `_isApp(originHeaderValue)` holds OR `_validateCSRF(xKAFKeyHeaderValue)` succeeds OR `_isExempted(operationName)` holds, and reject it otherwise.
attrs.title: Access policy: ValidateCSRF

attrs.requirement: The system shall forward the request headers `Referer`, `X-Ka-Service-Admin-Query` and those of `gqlclient.ForwardedUserRequestHeaderNames` to the requests it makes (_reqHeaderForwardingMap).
attrs.title: Header contract: _reqHeaderForwardingMap

attrs.requirement: The system shall hold `kaid_111`, `kaid_222` for `testQuery` in _safelistedKAIDsForOperation, which RateLimit reads.
attrs.title: Access table: _safelistedKAIDsForOperation[testQuery]

attrs.requirement: The system shall limit `testQuery` to 10 requests per minute by IP and to 3 requests per minute by account.
attrs.title: Rate limit: testQuery

attrs.requirement: The system shall limit `createProgram` to 300 requests per hour by IP and to 25 requests per 2 hours by account.
attrs.title: Rate limit: createProgram

attrs.requirement: The system shall limit `ipOnly` to 50 requests per 10 minutes by IP.
attrs.title: Rate limit: ipOnly

attrs.requirement: IF `r.Method == http.MethodPost` holds AND `os.Getenv("KA_IS_DEV_SERVER") != "0"` does not hold AND `validateIsTrustedClient(ctx, r.Header, "X-Ka-Task-Secret", useTaskSecret)` fails AND `validateIsTrustedClient(ctx, r.Header, "X-Ka-Service-Admin-Query", useServiceAdminSecret)` fails AND `gateway.ValidateCSRF(r.Header.Get("Origin"), r.Header.Get("X-Ka-Fkey"))` fails, THEN the system shall reject /graphql/, /tasks/graphql/ with the `StatusUnauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: /graphql/, /tasks/graphql/ (2)

attrs.requirement: IF `gateway.RateLimit(ctx, operationName(r), r.Header.Get("X-Ka-Kaid"))` holds, THEN the system shall reject /graphql/, /tasks/graphql/ with the `RateLimitExceeded` error.
attrs.title: Access control: /graphql/, /tasks/graphql/

attrs.requirement: The system shall send the secret `graphqlGateway.GatewayToBackendSecret` (backend_to_gateway_secret) in the `X-Ka-Gateway-Secret` header of the requests it makes.
attrs.title: Header contract: X-Ka-Gateway-Secret

attrs.requirement: The system shall accept a request checked by `_validatePermission` only when `isDev` holds OR (`queryIsSafelisted` holds AND `operationName == queryName` holds) OR `validateIsTrustedClient(ctx, requestHeaders, "X-Ka-Gateway-Secret", useGatewaySecret)` succeeds OR (`operationName == _devadminQueryOperationName` holds AND the caller has permission `CanPerformDynamicGraphqlQueries` for any user) OR (`queryIsSafelisted` holds AND `queryName` is a key of `oldMobileExceptions` AND `operationName == allowedOpnameInURL` holds), and reject it otherwise with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access policy: _validatePermission

attrs.requirement: The system shall map `ContentProgressV1` to `ContentProgressV1Query`, `DomainsQueryV4` to `""` in oldMobileExceptions, which _validatePermission reads.
attrs.title: Access table: oldMobileExceptions

attrs.requirement: IF `pubsub.DecodeAndValidatePushMsg(ctx, r)` fails, THEN the system shall reject /pubsub/push.
attrs.title: Access control: /pubsub/push

attrs.requirement: IF `r.URL.Query().Get("token") != _pushToken` holds, THEN the system shall reject /pubsub/token.
attrs.title: Access control: /pubsub/token

attrs.requirement: The system shall check access to /tasks/cleanup with `serve.CreateTaskHandler`.
attrs.title: Access check: /tasks/cleanup

attrs.requirement: The system shall check access to /tasks/archive with `serve.CreateTaskHandler`.
attrs.title: Access check: /tasks/archive

attrs.requirement: The system shall serve / only when `os.Getenv("KA_IS_DEV_SERVER") == "1"` holds.
attrs.title: Registration: /

attrs.requirement: The system shall serve /debug only when `os.Getenv("KA_IS_DEV_SERVER") == "1"` does not hold.
attrs.title: Registration: /debug

attrs.requirement: IF `validateIsTrustedClient(ctx, r.Header, "X-Ka-Secret-Key", useSettingsSecret)` fails, THEN the system shall reject /settings with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: /settings

attrs.requirement: IF `ctx.RequestIsTask()` does not hold, THEN the system shall reject /tasks/cleanup with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: /tasks/cleanup

attrs.requirement: IF `_ensureLoggedIn(ctx)` fails, THEN the system shall reject /dev.
attrs.title: Access control: /dev

attrs.requirement: IF `ctx.RequestIsTask()` does not hold, THEN the system shall reject requests through `CreateTaskHandler` with the `StatusUnauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: requests through `CreateTaskHandler`
